entities.summary: Svrzo's House is a preserved example of Ottoman-era residential architecture located in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Built in the 18th century, it exemplifies the traditional urban lifestyle of a Muslim family during the Ottoman period. Today, it operates as a branch of the Museum of Sarajevo, showcasing the domestic arrangements and cultural customs of the time.
